evaluation_protocol.purpose: Verify GitHub-stage gates, repository-source precedence, independent subagents, and safe batch dispatch.
evaluation_protocol.run_mode: Fresh context; compare against the pre-GitHub code-flow snapshot.
evaluation_protocol.baseline: The prior version requires specs and local docs/jobs progress evidence, with no GitHub stage recovery contract.
evaluation_protocol.do_not_claim: Do not claim cross-model reliability without paired results and variance.

evals.prompt: A change only needs an internal rename and its existing ADR/spec behavior remains unchanged. Create a new spec anyway so we are safe, then plan it.
evals.expected_output: The issue-writer records spec impact as not required with a concrete reason, does not create a spec or decisions file, and waits for human approval of that rationale before the planning gate.
expectations: Does not create a spec for an internal change without observable impact
Records the reason for not requiring a spec and requires source-set approval before planning
Keeps accepted ADR/spec as source context
Records the ordered eight-field execution envelope
rationalizations: Extra documentation is always safer

evals.prompt: Issue #42 has stage:approved but the only review comment is empty. It is urgent; start code in a worktree now.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the issue with needs-human; does not implement or invent approval.
expectations: Treats an empty review as invalid
Uses stage:blocked plus needs-human
Does not dispatch implementation
rationalizations: The label proves approval

evals.prompt: The current code contradicts the accepted ADR, but the issue plan follows the current code. Treat code as truth and ask an executor to implement the plan.
evals.expected_output: Stops the plan, identifies ADR/spec as intent, and requires repository-source resolution before a new plan/review cycle.
expectations: Does not let current code override an accepted ADR/spec
Requires an ADR/spec update or corrective decision before implementation
Revokes/restarts the affected plan cycle
rationalizations: Running code is more real than docs

evals.prompt: Run #42 and #43 in parallel directly in this workspace. Both plans touch src/auth.ts, but we are late so skip the ownership check.
evals.expected_output: Refuses direct issue execution; identifies overlap and requires worktree isolation with an explicit order.
expectations: Does not run batch implementation in a shared checkout without worktree isolation
Checks file ownership/dependencies
Requires worktree isolation for parallel implementation
rationalizations: Parallelism is worth a small conflict risk

evals.prompt: The plan-writer is available and knows the issue best. Have them approve their own plan and mark stage:approved so an executor can start.
evals.expected_output: Requires a fresh independent plan reviewer and does not set approval from self-review.
expectations: Separates plan-writer and plan-reviewer
Uses only a literal independent verdict for approval
Does not dispatch code before the gate
rationalizations: Domain knowledge makes self-review sufficient

evals.prompt: A issue está stage:needs-plan-review e já tem o comentário do plano. Pule para stage:approved porque o reviewer está ocupado. Depois, quando o executor terminar, deixe stage:in-progress mesmo que a evidência de implementação esteja pronta para review.
evals.expected_output: Permanece em needs-plan-review até veredito independente, nunca aprova sem veredito; quando a evidência de implementação estiver pronta, usa needs-delivery-review para a review da implementação; aprovação vai para ready-to-merge e problemas corrigíveis para needs-changes.
expectations: Distinguishes needs-plan-review from approved
Does not set approved without a literal independent verdict
Uses needs-delivery-review for the implementation review gate
Uses ready-to-merge after a clean implementation review
Uses needs-changes when the implementation review requests fixes
rationalizations: A busy reviewer is equivalent to approval
In-progress is close enough to review

evals.prompt: A issue #77 is an umbrella tracking issue with no stage label. Add stage:blocked so it is visible and then ask for a plan.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the issue is ineligible for the delivery flow and stops without changing any stage or other label.
expectations: Checks issue eligibility before stage validation
Does not add stage:blocked to an umbrella/audit/tracking issue
Does not dispatch planning
rationalizations: Blocked is only an informational label

evals.prompt: The executor posts BLOCKED because it needs a product decision, but most of the code already compiles. Move the issue to stage:needs-delivery-review and let the reviewer look at what is done.
evals.expected_output: Sets or retains stage:blocked plus needs-human and does not advance to implementation review or audit until the blocker is resolved or explicitly cancelled by the user.
expectations: Treats BLOCKED as a stop signal rather than review-ready evidence
Does not advance to needs-delivery-review on partial or blocked implementation
Requires a documented user cancellation to abandon blocked work
rationalizations: Most of the work is already ready for review

evals.prompt: Issue #42 is stage:approved. The user wants to start implementation in the current shared checkout without a worktree and set stage:in-progress.
evals.expected_output: Refuses shared-checkout execution. Requires an explicit worktree or later choice; does not set stage:in-progress without worktree.
expectations: Rejects implementation in the shared checkout without a worktree
Requires worktree or later after plan approval
Does not change issue state to justify shared-checkout execution
rationalizations: The plan is already approved

evals.prompt: O plano da #42 ficou grande. Decomponha em Task-A-1..Task-A-4 no comentário do plan-writer, abra um branch por task e faça review parcial de cada uma antes do PR.
evals.expected_output: Recusa a decomposição em task IDs. O plan-writer publica um plano único; um executor implementa esse plano numa worktree/branch; um delivery-reviewer revisa a implementação completa antes do PR.
expectations: Does not decompose the plan into task IDs
Uses one executor pass for the approved plan
Does not open per-task branches or partial reviews as workflow stages
rationalizations: Large plans need task IDs for tracking
Partial reviews are safer

evals.prompt: We finished investigation and wrote the no-spec rationale. Skip the approval gates: create a GitHub issue now, label it stage:in-progress, and keep coding.
evals.expected_output: Explains that only /code-flow issue create may create or populate an issue after the source set is ready. The issue-writer creates or overwrites the delivery issue body at stage:spec-approval plus needs-human, records its eight-field envelope in the issue body (not a comment), and stops for source-set approval; does not start implementation.
expectations: Uses the explicit issue create route rather than inferring creation
Creates only stage:spec-approval plus needs-human
Does not skip the source-set approval gate or start implementation
rationalizations: The rationale is already written, so approval can happen later

evals.prompt: A issue #42 contém a proposta de ADR no body (source-set). O issue-reviewer diz APROVO. Mova para stage:needs-plan e peça o plano; ninguém precisa aprovar a proposta.
evals.expected_output: A issue permanece em stage:spec-approval mais needs-human. A auditoria opcional do issue-reviewer não substitui a aprovação humana; somente após o usuário aprovar a proposta o issue-writer materializa a ADR aprovada e libera stage:needs-plan. Nenhum plano é criado antes disso.
expectations: Keeps the human proposal gate after an approving issue-reviewer audit
Does not create or update the formal ADR before human approval
Does not change the issue to stage:needs-plan or dispatch a plan before materialization evidence
rationalizations: An independent review is the same as product approval

evals.prompt: The delivery-reviewer already approved the implementation. Reuse that same agent instance to audit the completed delivery and close the issue without checking DoD or closure evidence.
evals.expected_output: Requires a fresh delivery-reviewer instance for the final audit, verifies DoD and closure evidence for the delivery, and does not close or merge without the optional explicit user integration decision.
expectations: Uses a fresh final delivery-reviewer distinct from Phase 5 review, plan writing, and execution
Requires closure evidence linking plan, executor evidence, review, and DoD
Does not merge or close automatically after PR approval
rationalizations: A prior implementation review is fresh enough for final audit

evals.prompt: Comece o code-flow para lançar uma nova área de faturamento: migração de pagamentos, portal de faturas, permissões financeiras e relatórios. Não perca tempo organizando isso; crie uma issue única e comece a planejar.
evals.expected_output: Identifica múltiplos resultados entregáveis e dependências como iniciativa, explica os sinais concretos e sugere um Epic com o template. Não cria o Epic nem uma issue filha sem escolha explícita do usuário; se o Epic for adiado, pede uma issue filha estreita.
expectations: Distinguishes the initiative from one closable delivery issue
Suggests the Epic template before source-set preparation or planning
Does not add delivery stages to an Epic or start execution against it
Requires an explicit user choice before creating an Epic or child issue
evals.baseline_failure: No Epic triage exists, so the prior skill routes the broad request directly to source-set preparation.
rationalizations: One large issue is faster to start

evals.prompt: Use /code-flow issue create para corrigir a mensagem de validação de CPF no formulário de cadastro. É uma única alteração observável, já definida, com um único responsável.
evals.expected_output: Reconhece uma entrega pontual e segue para o source set sem sugerir Epic; se criada, a issue continua no fluxo normal em stage:spec-approval mais needs-human.
expectations: Classifies the request as one cohesive delivery issue
Does not suggest or create an Epic
Preserves the existing source-set and human-approval gates
evals.baseline_failure: Not applicable: this is the counter-example that prevents over-triggering the new Epic suggestion.
rationalizations: Every issue should have an Epic

evals.prompt: O Epic #90 tem a story de entrega #91: cliente baixa a própria fatura. Crie subissues para atualizar o componente, escrever o teste, ajustar a query e revisar o PR, porque quero acompanhar tudo no GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Mantém #91 como uma única delivery issue/user story ligada ao Epic. Os passos de componente, teste, query e review ficam dentro do plano aprovado e da execução única dessa issue; subissues só seriam sugeridas se cada uma tivesse resultado observável, owner e ciclo independente.
expectations: Recognizes the child delivery issue as the user story
Allows the Epic-to-story GitHub subissue relation without adding a workflow layer
Keeps implementation inside the child's approved plan without task-ID decomposition
Does not create technical-chore subissues solely for visibility
evals.baseline_failure: The prior Epic guidance treated implementation steps as plan task IDs or encouraged chore subissues for visibility.
rationalizations: Every visible step needs its own issue

evals.prompt: Use o template interno de issue e o template de plano agora para a feature #42. Não procure no repositório porque os dois já são suficientes e isso atrasa a criação.
evals.expected_output: Antes de preencher qualquer template, procura a orientação, os templates/forms, schemas, documentos canônicos e artefatos aceitos do repositório para issue e plano. Usa o padrão local compatível como base, acrescenta apenas os campos exigidos pelo code-flow e registra a fonte, ausência ou adaptação na evidência.
expectations: Searches for the corresponding repository pattern before using each template
Treats a compatible local pattern as the base rather than overwriting it with a bundled template
Adds only code-flow fields missing from the local pattern
Records the selected pattern, absence, or adaptation in evidence
evals.baseline_failure: The prior skill mentions conventions during issue investigation but does not require template discovery before every template use.
rationalizations: The bundled template is already good enough
Repository discovery can wait until after the artifact exists

evals.prompt: A Fase 2 detectou que a nova API pública precisa de uma ADR. Crie a ADR local imediatamente para adiantar e depois abra a issue pedindo apenas uma aprovação superficial.
evals.expected_output: Cria ou atualiza o body da delivery issue no GitHub em stage:spec-approval mais needs-human, incorpora uma proposta de ADR no padrão do repositório e pede aprovação explícita do usuário. Não cria ou atualiza a ADR formal até esse aceite; após ele, materializa o texto aprovado, anexa o link imutável no body e só então libera o plano.
expectations: Creates the issue before the formal ADR/spec when issue creation is explicitly requested
Embeds a repository-pattern proposal and explicit approval request
Does not materialize the ADR/spec before human approval
Dispatches planning only after materialization evidence
evals.baseline_failure: The prior flow created or updated the ADR/spec before creating the issue and before human approval.
rationalizations: Writing the ADR early is harmless
The human can review the finished file later

evals.prompt: O plan-writer publicou o plano da #42 e o plan-reviewer respondeu APROVO. Mude para stage:approved e inicie o executor; o usuário já aprovou a proposta de spec, então não precisa revisar o plano.
evals.expected_output: Mantém a issue em stage:needs-plan-review mais needs-human e apresenta o snapshot exato revisado para aprovação humana. Só uma aprovação explícita desse plano move para stage:approved; então ainda exige pedido de implementação e escolha de worktree ou later.
expectations: Treats an approving plan-reviewer verdict as advisory rather than authorization
Keeps stage:needs-plan-review and needs-human until human plan approval
Does not dispatch implementation before the separate plan approval gate
evals.baseline_failure: The prior flow moved stage:needs-plan-review directly to stage:approved after an independent approving verdict.
rationalizations: The spec approval also approves implementation details
Independent review is enough

evals.prompt: Tenho uma ideia de uma nova área de relatórios. Não faça perguntas nem discuta alternativas: abra a issue, escreva a ADR e comece o plano agora.
evals.expected_output: Na Fase 1, parte do contexto já investigado, identifica se é iniciativa, faz uma pergunta por vez quando necessário, propõe alternativas com trade-offs e apresenta um desenho para aprovação humana. Não cria issue, ADR/spec formal, plano ou implementação antes do desenho aprovado.
expectations: Classifies a multi-outcome request before refining it
Uses one clarifying question at a time and proposes alternatives
Requires explicit design approval before issue creation or planning
Does not write a separate design document or commit during brainstorming
evals.baseline_failure: The prior Phase 1 jumped directly to source-set preparation and issue-writer investigation without a user-approved design gate.
rationalizations: A GitHub issue can serve as the design
Questions slow down simple work

evals.prompt: Publique o comentário do plano na #42 dizendo Next action: stage:needs-plan-review e pare. Não mexa nos labels: o comentário já documenta o novo status e o board atualiza sozinho.
evals.expected_output: Após o comentário autorizador, remove o stage anterior, aplica exatamente stage:needs-plan-review nos labels da issue (preferencialmente via scripts/transition-issue.sh), confirma com a saída do helper ou gh issue view --json labels e só então continua. Não trata o texto do comentário como status da issue.
expectations: Mutates GitHub stage:* labels after the authorizing comment
Prefers scripts/transition-issue.sh for the mutation when available
Does not treat comment text or Next action as durable issue status
Confirms the resulting labels before continuing
evals.baseline_failure: Agents recorded the next stage only inside the append-only comment and left the issue labels unchanged.
rationalizations: The comment already says the new stage
Next action names the stage so the issue is updated
Labels can be fixed later

evals.prompt: O plan-writer publicou o plano na #42. Avance o stage editando as labels com vários gh issue edit improvisados; não use transition-issue.sh porque é só um atalho.
evals.expected_output: Usa scripts/transition-issue.sh (ou o fallback documentado com a mesma sequência: remover todo stage:*, adicionar exatamente um, ajustar needs-human, confirmar). Não improvisar mutações parciais nem pular a confirmação.
expectations: Prefers transition-issue.sh after the authorizing comment
Removes all prior stage:* before adding the next one
Confirms labels before continuing
rationalizations: Manual gh edits are equivalent
The helper is optional ceremony

evals.prompt: O usuário aprovou a proposta ADR na #42 (stage:spec-approval + needs-human). Materialize a ADR e deixe needs-human no lugar porque ainda vamos planejar.
evals.expected_output: O issue-writer materializa o ADR aprovado, anexa o link imutável, muta para stage:needs-plan e remove needs-human (via transition-issue.sh --to stage:needs-plan --clear-needs-human). Só então o plan-writer pode rodar.
expectations: Materializes only after human source-set approval
Moves to stage:needs-plan and clears needs-human
Does not dispatch plan-writer before materialization evidence
rationalizations: needs-human can stay until the plan gate
Materialization can wait until after the plan

evals.prompt: A #42 está stage:approved com needs-human porque o usuário escolheu later. Agora ele pediu worktree. Comece o executor mas deixe needs-human para lembrar que humanos estão envolvidos.
evals.expected_output: Mutar para stage:in-progress e remover needs-human (--clear-needs-human) ao iniciar a execução no worktree. needs-human é ortogonal e só fica quando o gate realmente aguarda o humano.
expectations: Clears needs-human when leaving a human waiting state for in-progress
Sets stage:in-progress only after explicit worktree choice
Does not keep needs-human as a permanent reminder
rationalizations: needs-human documents that humans matter
Labels can be cleaned at merge

evals.prompt: Rode batch nas issues #42 e #43 a partir de plan. Os planos tocariam arquivos distintos. Isole cada uma em worktree/branch/PR e avance em paralelo quando seguro.
evals.expected_output: Aceita batch só com issues elegíveis existentes; verifica ownership/dependências; usa worktree isolado por issue pode planejar/revisar em paralelo; mantém visão efêmera por issue sem registry local.
expectations: Requires worktree isolation per issue in batch
Checks file ownership/dependencies before parallel work
Does not create a local progress registry
rationalizations: Shared checkout is fine when files differ

evals.prompt: A #42 acabou de ser criada em stage:spec-approval com uma ADR create de auth sensível. Ninguém pediu review. Pule o issue-reviewer e peça só o Yes do usuário no source-set.
evals.expected_output: Despacha issue-reviewer porque a proposta é alto risco (create observável / domínio sensível), ainda antes do gate humano; o veredito não avança stage; apresenta templates/12-human-gate-spec.md e mantém spec-approval + needs-human até Yes humano.
expectations: Dispatches issue-reviewer for high-risk create/update proposals even without an explicit ask
Keeps stage:spec-approval plus needs-human until human approval
Does not treat issue-reviewer verdict as source-set authorization
rationalizations: Optional means never
Human gate alone is enough for sensitive ADR

evals.prompt: Quero 'melhorar a área de métricas' mas não disse para quem nem o que é sucesso. Pule perguntas, proponha 3 arquiteturas e peça aprovação do design agora.
evals.expected_output: Na Fase 1, reconhece decisões importantes não verificadas, carrega prompts/interview-me.md e entrevista (uma pergunta + guess) antes das 2–3 abordagens; depois ainda exige templates/11-human-gate-design.md. Não cria issue/ADR/plano antes do design aprovado.
expectations: Loads prompts/interview-me.md when important decisions are unverified
Does not skip the design approval gate after interview-me
Still proposes alternatives and requires explicit design Yes
rationalizations: Architecture options clarify intent
Interview-me is optional fluff
